Blocks

Every page is text, photos and blocks. Tap + anywhere in the text to add one. It takes on your theme’s fonts, colors and shapes, so it always fits. Here is each one, live.

Questions and answers

Questions that unfold to reveal the answer, ready for Google to show in search results.

Can I use a block more than once on a page?

Yes. Each copy has its own content.

Can I turn a block off?

Yes, under Block settings. It can’t be added again until you turn it back on.
